protect_branch.description: Protect a repository branch (set push/merge/unprotect access levels). Use this to create or update protection rules for a branch or wildcard; use `get_protected_branch` to inspect existing rules first. The operation changes who may push, merge, or unprotect, may enable force-push or code-owner settings, requires maintainer-level permission, and returns the protection rule or a validation/permission error.

allow_force_push.description: Allow force push to the protected branch. Default: false

branch_name.description: Branch name or wildcard pattern to protect

code_owner_approval_required.description: Require code owner approval before merging (PREMIUM). Default: false

merge_access_level.description: Access level for merging (0=No access, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 60=Admin). GitLab default applies when omitted.

name.description: Deprecated alias for branch_name; prefer branch_name for consistency

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

push_access_level.description: Access level for pushing (0=No access, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 60=Admin). GitLab default applies when omitted.

unprotect_access_level.description: Access level for unprotecting (0=No access, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 60=Admin). GitLab default applies when omitted.
